full_judgment: 4. The case of Province of Bombay Vs. Khushaldas S. Advani, in 86 Calcutta Law Journal, 330 corresponding to A.I.R. 1950 S.C. 222 has been relied on by Mr. Khondker and he made particular reference to a passage at page 387 of 86 Calcutta Law Journal wherein the question arises whether a writ of certiorari lies against the Provincial Government. The principle enunciated therein has no manner of application in the facts of the present case.
